subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers immediately fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows, or must OpenClaw provide a migration or explicit operator adoption path before enforcing that boundary?
rationale: Both choices affect the security boundary and upgrade behavior for persisted sessions; code inspection cannot determine the intended policy safely.

options.title: Fail closed with migration
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and add a doctor/operator migration or explicit adoption flow before merge.

options.title: Temporary compatibility window
options.body: Preserve ownerless-row patch access temporarily with warnings while migrating rows to explicit ownership.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with migration
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and add a doctor/operator migration or explicit adoption flow before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session storage and projection boundary appears to be primarily owned by their recent merged work.
